Ausweather

5-DAY SEVERE WEATHER OUTLOOK

Hour-by-hour severe weather risk for Australia — wind, hail, flood and tornado — derived from the NOAA GFS model, plus a live radar loop and infrared satellite.

Pick a hazard or Max (overall threat), then scrub the timeline. The coloured bar under the timeline is the risk profile for the selected hazard — click it or a day label to jump. Click anywhere on the map (or a city) for a local breakdown.

The ⚠ button lists every ENH or higher risk window in the next five days, by region, with its peak time. Click a warning to jump straight to it. Risks are computed over land only, so offshore convection never raises a false warning.

Tap 📡 RADAR for the live loop: 12 past frames plus 30 min of nowcast, auto-refreshing every five minutes. Radar colours, smoothing and opacity are all in the ⬬ layers panel.

Risk levels are computed from raw model fields and are not official warnings. For authoritative forecasts and warnings visit bom.gov.au.
